visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands holds a large, crispy golden-brown fried chicken leg over a black plastic bento box filled with white rice, steamed cauliflower, and mixed greens. The scene is brightly lit with indoor lighting, emphasizing the oily texture of the skin. (2) Hands are shown pressing plastic lids onto several black bento containers lined up on a stainless steel kitchen counter. In the background, green and purple towels and other bento boxes in plastic bags are visible. (3) Dark red-brown tea is poured from a clear plastic dispenser into a small paper cup featuring cartoon character prints. The cup is then placed into a white sealing machine which applies a plastic film lid with a mechanical press. (4) Close-up shots feature various bento components: white rice mixed with red quinoa, a slice of green zucchini with char marks, and pinkish-red beef slices garnished with fried garlic chips being picked up by black chopsticks. (5) A spoon scoops up savory minced pork mixed with red chili peppers and basil from a bed of rice. Another shot shows a piece of grilled mackerel being broken apart by chopsticks, revealing white, flaky meat underneath. (6) A hand holds up a colorful printed menu listing 17 different bento types with pricing and opening hours. The final shot shows the outdoor storefront of '大和食堂' with a large round white sign and address banners under a clear daytime sky.
